Small and medium-sized schools are exploring the construction of artificial intelligence education extension courses that have regional characteristics and school features, incorporating artificial intelligence education into after-school services, club activities, and research practice within the educational system. Fully leveraging the advantages of Beijing's technological innovation resources, a batch of artificial intelligence education courses that connect higher education and secondary education, as well as school-enterprise joint courses, will be developed in collaboration with leading enterprises, universities, new research and development institutions, and industry associations.

(3) Create a batch of advanced innovation courses. Promote the establishment of a system and mechanism for the joint training of top innovative talents in artificial intelligence involving "universities + enterprises + high schools." In conjunction with the "Nursery" project, explore cooperation between universities and high schools to develop talent cultivation models in artificial intelligence, creating a series of advanced courses aimed at the early training of top innovative talents in artificial intelligence education. Through methods such as "ranking and leading," widely mobilize all sectors of society to participate and absorb social resources to continuously enrich and improve advanced innovation courses.

II. Build a normalized artificial intelligence education and teaching system.

(4) Coordinate the organization and implementation of classroom teaching. Starting from the autumn semester of 2025, all primary and secondary schools in the city will implement general education in artificial intelligence, with no less than 8 class hours per academic year, achieving comprehensive coverage for primary and secondary school students. Schools can set up artificial intelligence courses independently or integrate them with information technology, general technology, science, comprehensive practical activities, labor, and other courses. Innovate classroom teaching methods by utilizing AI companions, AI research assistants, and other intelligent agents to conduct human-computer dialogue learning, personalized adaptive learning, and integrate interdisciplinary, large unit, and project-based teaching designs, exploring new scenarios for "future classrooms" and constructing a new type of "teacher-student" interaction.
